notes: The remaining separate groups are real, not a mistake. The booklet builds separate models: (1) the robber's swamp stash (steps 1-7), (2) the ATV (steps 1-14), (3) the robber minifig and (4) the ranger minifig (p.2). The ranger holds the rod + clip holder + snake (p.21). That assembly is only held in his hand, not fastened to the ATV, so it stays with him. The stash, the ATV and the robber are never fastened together in the instructions.
Minifig hands are part of the torso (no separate hand pieces in inventory). Which of 6021844 / 6018687 is the robber vs ranger head is not stated; assigned arbitrarily.

Brown 6100774 assumed to be the ranger's cap; 4598955 assumed to be the robber's backpack/sack with the two money tiles (p.2). Page 9 shows it being moved to the stash; modelled on the robber's torso (extra 'back' port on the torso) as built on p.2. If it were moved to the stash it would join that model instead.

The four white clip plates (4613256) are modelled all on the right-hand mudguard (b16), one per stud. The blue 1x4 plate sits on one, the handle plate on top, a lamp tap clips onto each of the two outer ones (port on the clip plate left null because the catalogue tap's port is also a clip), and the handcuffs clip onto a third; positions are inferred from small pictures.

Grey mudguard plate 4244627 and white 1x2 plate 6051511 are both placed on the left mudguard; the black clip plate 4556158 with the two yellow headlights is assumed to clip onto the mudguard plate's side bar.

Pieces not in the catalogue (e.g. 6097585, 615726, 4210875, 4613256) were added as new types with descriptive names guessed from the pictures; their extra stud/anti-stud ports exist so each connection uses its own port. Element IDs come from the inventory page; colours are approximate.
Each wheel hub fits on a pin of a wheel holder (2 pins per holder, 2 holders). Wheels are a 4x repeat.
